prompt: Use case: precise reference-sheet prop repair. Keep the entire reference-sheet layout, every character turnaround, all character anatomy/clothing/colors, all books, red bookmark shapes, pencil/eraser, furniture, room, color swatches, and white background unchanged. From left to right the heads must point RIGHT, RIGHT, RIGHT, RIGHT, LEFT, RIGHT. There must be a generous clear shaft segment between the fourth right-pointing head and fifth left-pointing head: they must NEVER touch, overlap, cross or form an X. All six heads should be small enough for even spacing. Keep the shaft continuous across the whole paper route: no separate arrows with gaps. The red bookmark on the desk strip stays at the far-left start as currently. Keep both strips' existing endpoints and dimensions. No labels, numbers or extra arrows. Preserve clean crisp dark outlined cartoon art and the exact reference content elsewhere.

visualReview.note: Both reference strips have six separated arrowheads on a continuous shaft, fifth left; cast and props preserved.
